svg.title: Why Latching Relays
svg.desc: Latching relays switch on a short pulse and mechanically lock in position — contacts survive a power failure
svg.text: Latching relays switch on a short pulse and mechanically lock in position. No holding current, no coil heat, and — critically —
contacts survive a power failure. When power returns, the relay is exactly where you left it — the right choice
anywhere state retention matters: valve control, bypass switching, or any load that must not change state unexpectedly.
